title: Confirm: the product sends nothing to clients; feedback goes only to Jira and you?
bluf: Two tickets concern what the product sends. Feedback button: each submission becomes a Jira issue and an email to you (sharing with HP needs a hosted link, which is yours). Client collateral: three packs (before, during, after) as download or preview only, with pre-engagement wording marked PLACEHOLDER until supplied. Recommend we confirm that: nothing is emailed to a client by the product. Default if you do not tap: option A, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-90, HPSMPOC-91
